name: Access PeopleHR
description: Access PeopleHR, UK HR software: employees, holidays, absences, holiday entitlements, salaries, saved Query Builder reports, appraisals, training, timesheets, work patterns and recruitment vacancies. Integration API v4, API key sent in the JSON body of every POST.
instructions:
**Getting the API key**: in PeopleHR open **Settings > API** and create a key (a GUID such as 1a2b3c4d-...). When you create it you choose which resources (schemas) and which actions it may call: tick at least Employee, Holiday, Absence, Holiday Entitlements, Salary, Query Builder, Appraisal, Training and ATS for the read tools here, and add the Add Holiday / Add Absence actions only if you want the write tools. Put the key in `PEOPLEHR_API_KEY`. If the key has an IP allow-list, calls from AnythingMCP are refused unless its address is on it.

**How the API works**: every call is a POST to `https://api.peoplehr.net/<Resource>` (`/Employee`, `/Holiday`, `/Absence`, `/Salary`, `/Query` ...) with a JSON body holding `APIKey`, `Action` and the action's fields. The tools fill in the key and the action for you, so every read tool is a POST that only reads.

**Errors come back as HTTP 200.** Always read `Status` in the answer, not the HTTP code: 0 success, 10 no records found, 5 validation error or `Access Denied.`, 6 server error. `Access Denied.` means the key is not granted that action or schema (an unknown action name gives the same answer); ask the PeopleHR admin to add the grant. `isError` is unreliable; ignore it.

**Ids**: employees are addressed by their PeopleHR EmployeeId (e.g. `PW15`, max 15 characters). Start with `peoplehr_get_employee_directory` to find someone by name, then call the per-employee tools. Vacancies use their `Reference` (from `peoplehr_list_vacancies`), appraisals their `AppraisalId`.

**Dates** are `yyyy-MM-dd`. Other formats are either rejected or read day-first, so never send `MM/dd/yyyy` or an ISO date-time.

**Volumes and paging**: only `peoplehr_list_employees` pages (`limit` up to 500, `offset` in rows, `Result.Pagination.TotalRows`). The `peoplehr_list_*` tools for absences, holidays and salaries return the whole company in one answer, keyed by EmployeeId; narrow them with a date window.

**Employee fields** are wrapped: `"FirstName": {"DisplayValue": "Jane", "FieldHistory": []}`. `EmployeeStatus` is "1" for current staff and "2" for leavers.

**Tenant settings decide some answers**: `peoplehr_list_leavers` needs a separate GetAllLeavers grant even on a key with every other Employee action, and the vacancy and applicant tools need the recruitment (ATS) module to be active; otherwise both answer Status 5.

**Query Builder**: `peoplehr_run_query` runs a saved query by its exact name; the API cannot list queries, so ask the user for the name as it appears under Reports > Query Builder.

**Rate limit**: set per company by Access, not per key. A throttled call is Status 5 with a message like "API calls will be limited to a N per minute"; wait a minute and retry.
prerequisites: An administrator creates the API key in PeopleHR under **Settings > API** and ticks the resources and actions it may use; a key without a grant answers `Access Denied.`

PEOPLEHR_API_KEY.label: API key
PEOPLEHR_API_KEY.help: PeopleHR > Settings > API > create a key. Tick the schemas and actions it may call (Employee, Holiday, Absence, Salary, Query Builder ...).
PEOPLEHR_API_KEY.patternMessage: A PeopleHR API key is a GUID such as 1a2b3c4d-1111-2222-3333-444455556666.

verifyHints.403: The CDN in front of PeopleHR refused the request. Try again; if it persists, contact PeopleHR support with the time of the call.
verifyHints.404: PeopleHR has no such resource path. The API lives at https://api.peoplehr.net.
verifyHints.auth_failed: PeopleHR did not accept the key, or the key is not granted this action. Check the key under Settings > API and the actions ticked for it.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_company_information
tools.description: Return the company (tenant) the API key belongs to: CompanyId, SubDomain and CompanyName. No parameters; use it first to confirm the key works.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_directory
tools.description: Return every employee in one call as a compact directory: id, name, e-mail, job role, department, location, company, manager, start date and status (1 current, 2 leaver). Use it to find an EmployeeId by name.

include_leavers.description: "true" to include people who have left, "false" (default) for current staff only.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_employees
tools.description: Page through full employee records (contact, employment, bank and right-to-work details, each field as {DisplayValue, FieldHistory}). Result.Result holds the rows and Result.Pagination.TotalRows the total; raise offset by limit until you have them all.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip (a row offset, not a page number). Default 0.

include_leavers.description: "true" to include leavers, "false" (default) for current staff only.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee
tools.description: Return one employee's full record by EmployeeId: personal and contact details, job role, department, location, manager, employment type, holiday allowance, bank and right-to-work details, with each field's change history.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_leavers
tools.description: List the employees who have left the company with their leaving details. Needs its own grant on the API key (GetAllLeavers); without it PeopleHR answers Status 5 Access Denied.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_absences
tools.description: List one employee's absence (sickness and other absence) records: reason, start and end dates, duration, paid status, part of day, back-to-work interview and medical certificate details.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the absence window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the absence window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_absences
tools.description: List absence records for all employees in a date window. Result is an object keyed by EmployeeId, each holding that employee's absences; employees without absences are left out.

start_date.description: Start of the absence window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the absence window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_holidays
tools.description: List one employee's annual leave bookings: dates, duration in days or minutes, part of day, approval status, approver and comments. Use it to answer who is off when.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the holiday window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the holiday window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_holidays
tools.description: List annual leave bookings for all employees in a date window. Result is an object keyed by EmployeeId with each employee's bookings; good for team calendars and cover planning.

start_date.description: Start of the holiday window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the holiday window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_holiday_entitlement
tools.description: Return one employee's holiday entitlement per holiday year: period start and end, whether it is measured in days or hours, and the entitlement amount.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the entitlement window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the entitlement window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_holiday_entitlements
tools.description: Return holiday entitlement rows for every employee and holiday year in a date window: FullName, UniqueId, period, unit (days or hours) and amount. Without a window this is every year on record, so always pass one.

start_date.description: Start of the entitlement window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the entitlement window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_salary
tools.description: Return one employee's salary records: effective date, salary type, payment frequency, amount, total including entitlements, currency, deductions, entitlements and change reason. Needs the SALARY schema on the key.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

include_history.description: "true" for every salary record, "false" (default) for the current one only.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_salaries
tools.description: Return salary records for all employees. Result is an object keyed by EmployeeId with an array of salary records each; employees without a salary record are left out.

include_history.description: "true" for every salary record, "false" (default) for the current ones only.

tools.name: peoplehr_run_query
tools.description: Run a saved Query Builder query by its exact name and return its rows, keyed by the query's own column headings. Use it for reports the other tools do not cover; the query must exist in PeopleHR.

query_name.description: Exact name of a query saved in PeopleHR's Query Builder (Reports > Query Builder), including spaces and capitals. The API cannot list them.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_appraisals
tools.description: List one employee's appraisals (performance reviews): AppraisalId, review date, reviewer, notes, objectives, action plan and the tenant's custom appraisal columns.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_appraisal
tools.description: Return one appraisal by its AppraisalId with review date, reviewer, notes, objectives, action plan and custom columns. Get the id from peoplehr_get_employee_appraisals.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_training
tools.description: List training records: TrainingId, training type, description, importance, status, start, end and expiry dates, cost, provider and notes. Training is read per employee.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_other_events
tools.description: List one employee's other events (leave types beyond holiday and absence, such as jury duty, training days or appointments) with reason, dates, duration, status and approver.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the event window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the event window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_lateness
tools.description: List one employee's lateness records: the date, how many minutes late and comments, optionally within a date window.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the lateness window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the lateness window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_employee_timesheets
tools.description: List one employee's timesheets per day with up to 15 time-in and time-out pairs (HH:mm:ss) and comments, within a date window. Needs the TIMESHEET schema on the key.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

start_date.description: Start of the timesheet window, yyyy-MM-dd. Optional; omit together with end_date for all records.

end_date.description: End of the timesheet window, yyyy-MM-dd. Must be on or after start_date.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_work_patterns
tools.description: List the company's work patterns with, per week and weekday, the working days and minutes. Filter by name or id; use it to explain how holiday and absence durations are counted.

work_pattern_name.description: Optional work pattern name to filter on.

work_pattern_id.description: Optional work pattern id to filter on.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_vacancies
tools.description: List the recruitment vacancies (ATS): name, reference, job title, company, location, department, status, closing date, salary range and vacancy type. Needs the ATS schema on the key.

tools.name: peoplehr_get_vacancy
tools.description: Return one vacancy by its reference with description, job description, closing date, salary range and application questions. Get the reference from peoplehr_list_vacancies.

vacancy_reference.description: The vacancy's Reference value from peoplehr_list_vacancies, e.g. VA4.

tools.name: peoplehr_list_applicants
tools.description: List the applicants of one vacancy with ApplicantId, first and last name and e-mail address. Get the vacancy reference from peoplehr_list_vacancies.

vacancy_reference.description: The vacancy's Reference value from peoplehr_list_vacancies.

tools.name: peoplehr_add_holiday
tools.description: Book annual leave for an employee. For a day or more set duration_type 1 and duration_in_days; for less than a day set duration_type 2, duration_in_minutes and part_of_day. Rejected when it overlaps other leave.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

duration_type.description: 1 for a day or more, 2 for less than a day.

duration_in_days.description: Number of working days, e.g. "1" or "0.5". Required by the API; send "0" for part-day leave.

duration_in_minutes.description: Minutes of leave for part-day bookings, e.g. "240". Required by the API; send "0" for whole days.

part_of_day.description: AM or PM, for part-day leave.

comments.description: Optional comment stored with the booking.

tools.name: peoplehr_add_absence
tools.description: Record an absence (e.g. sickness) for an employee with reason, dates, duration and paid status. The reason must exist in the tenant's absence reason list; overlapping leave is rejected.

employee_id.description: PeopleHR employee id as shown on the employee's profile, e.g. PW15 (at most 15 characters). Get it from peoplehr_get_employee_directory.

duration_type.description: 1 for a day or more, 2 for half a day, 3 for a quarter day.

reason.description: Absence reason exactly as in the tenant's absence reason list, e.g. Sickness.

part_of_day.description: AM or PM, for part-day absences.

absence_paid_status.description: Paid status code as configured in PeopleHR, e.g. "1" for paid.

emergency_leave.description: "true" if this is emergency leave, otherwise "false".
